items.title: FIX: Show-CronAiAthonTool.ps1 ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â accAmber colour undefined causing ForeColor null crash (P025/P022)
items.description: Variable $accAmber was missing from the palette block, causing System.Drawing.Color null assignment when the Cron Dashboard rendered the BOM Overview panel. Crash: Cannot convert null to type System.Drawing.Color at ~line 2308. Fix: added $accAmber = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(220,160,40) to palette block after $accYellow.

items.title: FIX: PwShGUICore.psm1 ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â Get-ProjectPath returns null after -Force reimport resets $script:_PathRegistry
items.description: Import-Module -Force on PwShGUICore.psm1 (from PwSh-HelpFilesUpdateSource-ReR.psm1 and others) re-executes the module body, resetting $script:_PathRegistry to @{}. All subsequent Get-ProjectPath calls return $null. Fix: added auto-reinit guard in Get-ProjectPath ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â if registry is empty, derives ScriptDir from Split-Path $PSScriptRoot and calls Initialize-CorePaths, then logs a Warning. Also fixed previously incorrect warning message referencing Initialize-CoreModule.

items.title: FIX: Main-GUI.ps1 ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â Test-Path $null crash in security checklist + scriptFolders config (P022 x6)
items.description: Six sites in Main-GUI.ps1 called Test-Path with a $null argument when Get-ProjectPath returned $null after registry reset. Crash: Mandatory parameter -Path was $null. Fixed sites: line 7732 (AssistedSASC module path), line 7735 (SASC adapters module path), line 7755 (config path), line 9822 (scriptFoldersConfigPath existence check), Get-ScriptFoldersConfig body, Save-ScriptFoldersConfig body. All wrapped with [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace() guards before Test-Path.

items.title: FIX: PwShGUI-Checklists.xhtml ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â Agents tab never loads: hash nav broken, no showTab hook, status label stuck
items.description: Three compounding JS bugs prevented the Agents tab from rendering. (1) Hash IIFE only tried exact element ID ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â #Agents never matched agents-tab div. (2) showTab() had no agents-tab branch so XHR loadAgentRegistry() was never retried on activation. (3) renderAgentTable() status label guard /[Ll]oading/ blocked final count write. All three fixed: hash nav now tries lowercase and lowercase+-tab suffix; showTab has agents-tab handler; guard narrowed to /[Rr]efreshing/ only.
